header.status_line: Sitz is coded on Mark 16: a text-level grounding (year ~70 CE, phase 'Formation') + 60/60 moves each carry a per-move world-note. The 10-category substrate is tagged (4 categories); the 4-layer Sitz im Leben (sitz_layers) is NOT populated for Mark 16 -- an honest coverage gap.

what_it_is: Sitz codes the WORLD a text came out of -- the conditions of its making. For Mark 16 that is the immediate shadow of the First Jewish-Roman War and the 70 CE destruction of the Temple: the empty-tomb narrative reframed for a community whose cultic center has just been annihilated, written under Roman imperial administration, circulating in the diaspora house-church network. Two closed taxonomies frame it: the 4-LAYER Sitz im Leben (which layers of world condition the text) and the 10-CATEGORY civilizational substrate (the year/location pressure-axes).
why_it_matters: Sitz is the axis that keeps two texts from being read as if they faced the same world -- the same move (an empty tomb, a command to go) means different things post-70-CE than it would in a stable imperial center. It is also where a condition the text does NOT respond to becomes visible: a pressure present in the world but absent from the text is a coded silence.

how_it_works.you_give_it: a coded text (its moves) + what is known of its date/place.
how_it_works.the_method_does: writes a text-level grounding (year, phase, native periodization, a Sitz summary), tags the 4-layer Sitz im Leben + the 10-category substrate, and attaches a per-move world-note (the specific condition each move presupposes).
how_it_works.you_get_back: the text and each move carrying their world-conditions, ready for the Enriched move.

pipeline_context.note: sibling terms glossed so the card stands alone.
pipeline_context.move: one small action a text makes (agent does an operation to something, with a result) -- the unit Decompose produces.
pipeline_context.Decompose: the node that breaks a passage into moves; Sitz (in Situate) runs alongside it.
pipeline_context.Situate: the parent node: attaches context to each move; Sitz is its 'conditions' aspect.
pipeline_context.Sitz im Leben: biblical-studies term (form criticism) for a text's life-setting -- the conditions of its making; here generalised cross-tradition.
pipeline_context.the 4-layer Sitz im Leben: which KINDS of world-condition frame the text: personal-biography / cultural-intellectual / polemical / ecological-material-geographical (Refinement #5).
pipeline_context.the 10-category substrate: the year/location pressure-axes (political-institutional, migration-diaspora, ...): the material conditions of the era (IRR111).
pipeline_context.the Enriched move: a move + its attached Situate context -- the waist the outputs fan out from.
pipeline_context.PI: the principal investigator (the researcher) -- who locks methodology calls.

where_saved.plain: Text-level grounding saves to source_grounding (@ the base key MARK-16); per-move world-notes to source_move.sitz (@ the live moveset). Resolve the family via text_checkout.

honest_limits: THE 4-LAYER SITZ IM LEBEN IS EMPTY for Mark 16. sitz_categories (the 10-category substrate) is coded (4 categories: political_institutional, migration_diaspora, demographic_social, communication_media), but sitz_layers (personal-biography / cultural-intellectual / polemical / ecological-material-geographical) is unpopulated -- a real coverage gap, not a design choice. Owed on the next coding pass.
The two taxonomies are controlled-by-convention (documented definitions, no queryable vocab table); OWED a live definitions store the drawer reads (same as the other non-Frame closed sets).
The text-level Sitz is a single reconstructed grounding; the per-move notes are one coder, one pass, engine-proposed, not reliability-tested.
Cold Read + vs-Wild owed on this card.
